_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for term schedule data (Fall 2026). Drives pages/support/course-schedule.html via render_course_schedule.py. The companion markdown calendar (IS2053_2026-07-08_Fall_2026_Calendar.md) is the canonical human reference; this JSON mirrors its tables in machine form.

term.name: Fall 2026
term.intro_html: Fall 2026 runs as a full 16-week term from Wed Aug 19 through Fri Dec 11. Each module is three weeks. Modules 1–4 follow the same cadence: two BookEx exercises, two BUILD/ENHANCE labs, and a MASTER capstone, with a short multiple-choice exam that opens at the end of Week 2 and closes early in Week 3—so it sits inside its own module and never competes with the capstone. Module 5 (Chapter 10 only) is a single BookEx and two labs (BUILD + MASTER), with no Lab 5.3, and its exam runs in the finals period. Fall Break (Oct 12–18) and Thanksgiving (Nov 23–29) are full weeks off with nothing due.

cadence.footer_html: Module exams open Sunday at the end of Week 2 and close Tuesday of Week 3. Module 3 shifts to Mon–Wed of Week 3 for Fall Break; Module 5 runs Sun Dec 6–Tue Dec 8 in the finals period.

rows.exam_html: Mon Oct 19 – Wed Oct 21 (post-break)

schedule.closingRow_html: Tue Dec 8 — Module 5 Exam closes 11:59 PM  ·  Fri Dec 11 — END OF TERM

module5Differs.intro_html: Module 5 is the only module that does not run the full BUILD/ENHANCE/MASTER three-lab cadence. Chapter 11 (Inheritance) was dropped from the course, so there is no Lab 5.3. What remains is Chapter 10 (Classes and Objects) split across two labs:
labs_html: Lab 5.1 (BUILD) — You build the City class from scratch and refactor your Module 4 game to use City objects.
Lab 5.2 (MASTER) — You build the Player class against a provided lab-5-2.py, completing the full object-oriented version of the game.
module5Differs.explanation_html: Lab 5.1 (BUILD) keeps the same Sunday deadline as every other Lab X.1 (Sun Nov 22). After the Thanksgiving break week (Nov 23–29), Lab 5.2 (MASTER) is due Sun Dec 6, and the Module 5 exam opens that same day and closes Tue Dec 8 in the finals period — the Monday–Tuesday window means no one has to do both on Sunday.

termDates.termBoundaries_html: First Day: Wed Aug 19  ·  Last Day of Classes: Thu Dec 3  ·  Finals: Dec 7–11  ·  Final Grades Due: Mon Dec 14
termDates.holidaysFooter_html: Fall Break and Thanksgiving are genuine no-work weeks — nothing is due. Labor Day needs no accommodation; it falls on an off-day with nothing due. Every module unlocks in full at the start of its Week 1, so you may work ahead through a break if you like.

dueTimesCallout.title: All Due Times Are 11:59 p.m. US Central Time
dueTimesCallout.body_html: BookEx (Friday) and Lab (Sunday) deadlines are 11:59 p.m. US Central Time (the home time zone of UT San Antonio) on their due date, no matter where you are located. Module exams open Sunday at the end of Week 2 and close the following Tuesday at the same 11:59 p.m. (Module 3 shifts to Monday–Wednesday for Fall Break; Module 5 runs Sun Dec 6–Tue Dec 8.) Canvas enforces these cutoffs automatically, so submit early to be safe.
